program.section_heading: Noncredit ESL Milestone for Multilingual Speakers - Introduction to Health Careers Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Identify the educational requirements necessary to complete a healthcare career, and give a presentation about a selected healthcare career, including educational requirements, licensure or certification, salary, and career mobility.
Participate in introductory health-related discussions effectively, take clear notes, and give short oral presentations.
Evaluate brief written health-related communication and compose and organize sentences into effective paragraphs and short documents.
Apply techniques of written communication, sentence structure, word usage, punctuation, and spelling.

Write and edit paragraphs and short essays on academic topics and effectively use English as applied in Health Science classes as well as workplace environments in one of the Health Careers. Illustrate comprehension of introductory readings in the field of Health Science by quoting outside sources and incorporating them into intermediate-level writing.
